versions.subject: Merge PR #4961 from @tsale - Add multiples rules and updates
versions.detection:
selection:
    ParentImage|endswith:
        - '\cmd.exe'
        - '\powershell.exe'
        - '\pwsh.exe'
    Image|endswith: '\explorer.exe'
    CommandLine|contains: 'shell:mycomputerfolder'
condition: selection
